cat > /workspace/tmp/inference_check.py <<'PY'
import sys,random,itertools,math
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as s
from fractions import Fraction as F
random.seed(9463)
for case in range(150):
    n=random.randrange(1,8)
    edges=[(2*i+1,2*i+2) for i in range(n)]
    contexts=[]
    scopes=[]
    for i in range(n):
        candidates=list(range(i,min(n,i+3)))
        # Only contexts corresponding to other variables.
        if i: candidates.append(i-1)
        candidates=[x for x in candidates if x!=i]
        d={}
        for k in range(random.randrange(1,15)):
            lr=[-1]+[2*x+r for x in candidates for r in range(2)]
            l,r=random.choice(lr),random.choice(lr)
            d[(l,r)]=random.randrange(1,19)
        contexts.append(d)
        scopes.append(tuple(sorted({i}|{c//2 for pair in d for c in pair if c>=0})))
    # Direct construction of induced tree and width test.
    graph=[set() for _ in range(n)]
    for sc in scopes:
        for v in sc:graph[v].update(set(sc)-{v})
    bags=[];parents=[]
    for i in range(n):
        ns=sorted(graph[i]);bags.append((i,*ns));parents.append(min(ns) if ns else -1)
        for v in ns:
            graph[v].remove(i);graph[v].update(set(ns)-{v})
        graph[i].clear()
    if any(len(b)>5 for b in bags):continue
    got=s.infer(edges,contexts,scopes,bags,parents)
    z=0;nums=[[0]*3 for _ in range(n)]
    for xs in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=n):
        weight=1
        for i,ctx in enumerate(contexts):
            v=0
            for (l,r),c in ctx.items():
                lt=0 if l<0 else 2-xs[l//2] if l%2 else xs[l//2]
                rt=2 if r<0 else 2-xs[r//2] if r%2 else xs[r//2]
                if xs[i]==s.G[lt][rt]:v+=c
            weight*=v
        z+=weight
        for i,t in enumerate(xs):nums[i][t]+=weight
    if not z:assert got is None
    else:
        for e,num in zip(edges,nums):
            m=got[e]
            assert [F(v,m[3]) for v in m[:3]]==[F(v,z) for v in num]
print('synthetic exact enumeration OK')
PY
cd /workspace && python3 -B tmp/inference_check.py && time python3 -I submission/main.py < tmp/stress.json > tmp/stress.out
